title: Redaction rules
description: A list of redaction rules (redaction-spec.md): the packaged default definition, or the repository's own rules under redaction_rules in .backlog/config.json.

id.description: Used only by validation to name the rule.

description.description: What the rule hides, in words.

find.description: A regular expression in RE2 syntax (matched in linear time).

replace.description: The text put in place of each match; $1, $2, ... insert groups of the match.

properties.description: The item properties the rule applies to; absent: every text property and every text inside lists.

applies.description: always: applied even when redact_pii is false (credentials); when-enabled: only when redact_pii is true.
